all.description: Developed an AI-powered voice-based sales agent using Python, Flask, Twilio API, and Speech Recognition. all.description: A phone-based voice AI customer-support agent. Twilio streams live call audio to this FastAPI service over a WebSocket; each turn it transcribes (STT) → retrieves answers from a RAG knowledge base → reasons with an LLM → speaks back (TTS) in a streaming loop.

all.description: SupportFlow AI is an AI-powered enterprise customer support and operations platform built with multi-agent AI architecture. It combines intelligent customer support automation, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, customer identity verification, fraud detection, risk assessment, automated email communication, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
all.descriptionZh: SupportFlow AI 是一款基于多智能体 AI 架构构建的、由人工智能驱动的企业级客户支持与运营平台。它集成了智能客户支持自动化、基于 RAG 的知识检索、客户身份验证、欺诈检测、风险评估、自动化电子邮件沟通以及人工介入审批等功能。

all.description: A sequential, three-agent customer-support application built with CrewAI and Streamlit. The first agent uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a local text knowledge base with FAISS; the second searches the public web; the third records the interaction.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于CrewAI和Streamlit构建的、由三个客服机器人组成的顺序式客户支持应用程序。第一个机器人利用FAISS对本地文本知识库进行检索增强生成（RAG）；第二个在公开网络上进行搜索；第三个则记录交互过程。

all.description: SE-AI-B12-2-W4-D5-A 3-agent CrewAI support assistant. It answers from your own PDF knowledge base first (FAISS RAG), searches the web only when the PDF has no answer, and logs every conversation to Google Sheets with its source: RAG, WEB or NONE.
all.descriptionZh: SE-AI-B12-2-W4-D5-A 是一款由 3 个代理组成的 CrewAI 支持助手。它会优先从您自己的 PDF 知识库中进行回答（FAISS RAG），仅当 PDF 中没有答案时才会搜索网络，并将每次对话连同其来源（RAG、WEB 或 NONE）记录到 Google 表格中。

all.description: AI-powered customer support system with ticket management, SLA tracking, knowledge base versioning, RAG assistance, document analysis, and multilingual conversations.
all.descriptionZh: 一款基于人工智能的客户支持系统，具备工单管理、SLA跟踪、知识库版本控制、RAG辅助、文档分析以及多语言对话功能。

all.description: A sequential, three-agent customer-support application built with CrewAI and Streamlit. The first agent uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a local text knowledge base with FAISS; the second searches the public web; the third records the interaction.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于CrewAI和Streamlit构建的、由三个客服机器人组成的顺序式客户支持应用程序。第一个机器人利用FAISS对本地文本知识库进行检索增强生成（RAG）；第二个在公开网络上进行搜索；第三个则记录交互过程。

all.description: A sequential, three-agent customer-support application built with CrewAI and Streamlit. The first agent uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a local text knowledge base with FAISS; the second searches the public web; the third records the interaction.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于CrewAI和Streamlit构建的、由三个客服机器人组成的顺序式客户支持应用程序。第一个机器人利用FAISS对本地文本知识库进行检索增强生成（RAG）；第二个在公开网络上进行搜索；第三个则记录交互过程。

all.description: A LangChain-powered RAG customer support chatbot that answers questions from uploaded knowledge-base documents using semantic search, FAISS vector storage, Google Gemini, and source-grounded responses.
all.descriptionZh: 一款基于LangChain的RAG客户支持聊天机器人，它利用语义搜索、FAISS向量存储、Google Gemini以及基于来源的回答，根据上传的知识库文档来回答问题。

all.description: Built an AI-powered customer support workflow using n8n that classifies incoming Gmail messages, retrieves relevant answers from a company knowledge base, generates contextual replies, and automatically labels and responds to customer emails—reducing repetitive manual work and improving support efficiency.
all.descriptionZh: 利用 n8n 构建了一个基于人工智能的客户支持工作流，该工作流能够对收到的 Gmail 邮件进行分类，从公司知识库中检索相关答案，生成符合上下文的回复，并自动标记和回复客户邮件——从而减少了重复性的人工操作，提高了支持效率。

all.description: Drafts grounded replies to repeat customer questions from the business's own knowledge base, in the owner's tone.
all.descriptionZh: Drafts 会根据企业自身的知识库，以企业主特有的语气，自动生成针对老客户常见问题的回复草稿。

all.description: A customer support agent built with the Strands Agents SDK and deployed on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It remembers customers across sessions, answers product and policy questions from a knowledge base, calculates loyalty discounts in a secure sandbox, browses the web, and calls backend tools through an AgentCore Gateway.
all.descriptionZh: 这是一个基于 Strands Agents SDK 构建并部署在 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 上的客户支持机器人。它能够在不同会话中记住客户信息，通过知识库回答有关产品和政策的问题，在安全的沙箱环境中计算忠诚度折扣，浏览网页，并通过 AgentCore Gateway 调用后端工具。

all.description: A multi-tenant AI-powered customer support platform with automated resolutions, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, ticket escalation, analytics, and role-based access control.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于人工智能的多租户客户支持平台，具备自动解决、基于RAG的知识检索、工单升级、分析以及基于角色的访问控制等功能。

all.description: AI agent that triages customer support tickets: urgency, key info, knowledge base search, and routing (OpenAI GPT, Node.js + TypeScript)
all.descriptionZh: 用于对客户支持工单进行分流的AI代理：紧急程度评估、关键信息提取、知识库搜索及工单分流（OpenAI GPT、Node.js + TypeScript）

all.description: Production Enterprise AI Customer Support Chatbot & RAG Knowledge-Base Suite (Multi-Channel Live Chat, Ticket Deflection & Zendesk/Freshdesk Integration Engine)
all.descriptionZh: 企业级AI客户支持聊天机器人及RAG知识库套件（多渠道实时聊天、工单分流及Zendesk/Freshdesk集成引擎）

all.description: SupportSphere AI is a full-stack customer-support web app. Customers get an AI assistant that falls back between Groq and Google Gemini, a searchable help centre and ticket tracking. Admins get analytics, a knowledge-base editor and user management.
all.descriptionZh: SupportSphere AI 是一款全栈式客户支持 Web 应用。客户可获得一位在 Groq 和 Google Gemini 之间切换的 AI 助手，以及可搜索的帮助中心和工单跟踪功能。管理员则可使用分析工具、知识库编辑器和用户管理功能。

all.description: Persian-first customer support platform with real-time chat, AI-assisted responses, knowledge base, operator inbox, and human handoff. Built with React and FastAPI.
all.descriptionZh: 首个以波斯语为主的客户支持平台，提供实时聊天、AI辅助回复、知识库、客服收件箱及人工接手功能。采用React和FastAPI构建。

all.description: self-hosted, enterprise-grade AI customer support workflow built in n8n (Docker). Uses ChromaDB vector search and Ollama to process unread Gmail inquiries, enforce strict Knowledge Base grounding, route responses through a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gate, auto-generate Gmail drafts, apply tracking labels, and output local SSH audit logs.
all.descriptionZh: 基于 n8n（Docker）构建的自托管、企业级 AI 客户支持工作流。 该系统利用 ChromaDB 向量搜索和 Ollama 处理未读的 Gmail 咨询，严格执行知识库锚定，通过“人工介入”（HITL）审批流程进行响应分流，自动生成 Gmail 草稿，应用跟踪标签，并输出本地 SSH 审计日志。

all.description: Enterprise-ready, multi-agent AI customer support desk built with Streamlit and the OpenAI API. Features automated RAG-based knowledge retrieval, human-in-the-loop admin review workflows, real-time audit logging, and automated user notifications.
all.descriptionZh: 一款基于 Streamlit 和 OpenAI API 构建的、面向企业级应用的多智能体 AI 客户支持平台。具备基于 RAG 的自动化知识检索、人工参与的管理员审核工作流、实时审计日志记录以及自动化用户通知等功能。

all.description: An AI-assisted customer support platform that drafts grounded response from a knowledge base, keeps humans in control, and measure AI quality with repeated evaluations
all.descriptionZh: 一款人工智能辅助的客户支持平台，它能根据知识库起草有依据的回复，确保人工始终掌握控制权，并通过反复评估来衡量人工智能的质量

all.description: 🎧 SupportForge MCP — Autonomous Customer Support Engineering: support architecture, knowledge base deflection, honest AI automation, difficult-conversation playbooks & team scaling. 5 tools on Cloudflare Workers.
all.descriptionZh: 🎧 SupportForge MCP — 自主客户支持工程：支持架构、知识库分流、诚实的人工智能自动化、棘手对话应对指南及团队规模扩展。基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 5 款工具。

all.description: SupportIQ is a learning-oriented, production-minded AI customer support portal. It combines a tenant-aware knowledge base, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), ticket intelligence, agent assistance, lightweight workflow automation, and evaluation/operations capabilities.
all.descriptionZh: SupportIQ 是一个以学习为导向、注重实际应用的人工智能客户支持门户。它集成了支持租户识别的知识库、检索增强生成（RAG）、工单智能、客服代表辅助、轻量级工作流自动化以及评估/运维功能。

all.description: AI customer support — 19-article knowledge base, source-linked citations, 3 conversation states, deflection-rate tracking, 5 Prisma models. Next.js 14 + TypeScript.
all.descriptionZh: AI客户支持——包含19篇文章的知识库、带来源链接的引用、3种对话状态、转接率跟踪、5个Prisma模型。Next.js 14 + TypeScript。

all.description: Customer support chat with an AI agent grounded in your own knowledge base
all.descriptionZh: 基于您自有知识库的AI客服聊天功能

all.description: AI Customer Support Agent built with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands SDK, MCP Gateway, Knowledge Base RAG, AgentCore Memory, Code Interpreter, and Browser Tool.
all.descriptionZh: 基于 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore、Strands SDK、MCP Gateway、知识库 RAG、AgentCore Memory、代码解释器和浏览器工具构建的 AI 客户支持代理。

all.description: AI customer support agent on AWS Bedrock AgentCore: knowledge base retrieval, long-term memory, gateway-based order/refund tools, and sandboxed loyalty discount calculations. Built with Strands Agents and Amazon Nova.
all.descriptionZh: 基于 AWS Bedrock AgentCore 的 AI 客户支持代理：支持知识库检索、长期记忆、基于网关的订单/退款工具，以及在沙箱环境中进行的忠诚度折扣计算。采用 Strands Agents 和 Amazon Nova 构建。

all.description: AI customer support & table reservations: React + TanStack Start frontend, secure server proxy, n8n workflows with a Google Sheets knowledge base, Gemini fallback, Gmail escalation. Live demo on Cloudflare.
all.descriptionZh: AI客户支持与餐桌预订：基于React + TanStack Start的前端，安全的服务器代理，结合Google Sheets知识库的n8n工作流，Gemini备用方案，以及Gmail升级处理。Cloudflare上的实时演示。

all.description: A Multi-Agent AI Customer Support Assistant built using Python, FastAPI, RAG, and LLMs. It routes customer queries to specialized AI agents for billing, technical support, product inquiries, complaints, and FAQs. Uses a company knowledge base to generate relevant answers and MongoDB to store conversation history.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于 Python、FastAPI、RAG 和大型语言模型（LLMs）构建的多智能体人工智能客户支持助手。它会将客户咨询分流至专门的人工智能代理，分别处理账单、技术支持、产品咨询、投诉和常见问题解答。该系统利用公司知识库生成相关答案，并使用 MongoDB 存储对话记录。

all.description: Support engineers resolve dozens of tickets a week, but nobody has time to turn those messy comment threads into clean documentation. This Java utility takes raw ticket resolution notes, scrubs customer PII (emails/phone numbers) using regex first as a safety guardrail, and calls the OpenAI API to generate a standardized Markdown KB article.
all.descriptionZh: 支持工程师每周要处理几十个工单，但没人有时间将那些杂乱无章的评论串整理成条理清晰的文档。这款 Java 工具会提取原始的工单处理记录，首先使用正则表达式过滤掉客户的个人身份信息（电子邮件/电话号码）作为安全防护措施，然后调用 OpenAI API 生成符合标准的 Markdown 知识库文章。

all.description: AI-powered customer support agent built with LangGraph — answers questions from your own knowledge base, hedges when uncertain, and escalates to a human with full context when needed.
all.descriptionZh: 基于 LangGraph 构建的 AI 驱动型客户支持代理——能够从您自己的知识库中回答问题，在不确定时会谨慎表述，并在需要时将问题连同完整背景信息一并转交给人工处理。

all.description: Voice-based AI customer support assistant using Gemini, Gnani STT/TTS, and knowledge retrieval
all.descriptionZh: 基于Gemini、Gnani STT/TTS以及知识检索的语音人工智能客户服务助手

all.description: Java OOP project for IoT device monitoring and alert management.
all.descriptionZh: 用于物联网设备监控和警报管理的Java面向对象编程（OOP）项目。

all.description: IoT wearable monitoring system for cyclists featuring a real-time dashboard, team management, and emergency alerts.
all.descriptionZh: 一款面向骑行者的物联网可穿戴监测系统，具备实时仪表盘、团队管理和紧急警报功能。

all.description: GridPilot – Smart Grid Monitoring and Analytics Dashboard for Real-Time Electrical Parameter Monitoring, Alert Detection, and Data Visualization.
all.descriptionZh: GridPilot——用于实时监测电气参数、警报检测和数据可视化的智能电网监控与分析仪表盘。

all.description: An Excel-based digital banking request management dashboard featuring SLA monitoring, priority tracking, overdue alerts, and automated reporting.
all.descriptionZh: 一个基于 Excel 的数字银行请求管理仪表盘，具备 SLA 监控、优先级跟踪、逾期提醒和自动报告功能。

all.description: UiPath-based automation project for cloud infrastructure monitoring and alert management.
all.descriptionZh: 基于UiPath的云基础设施监控和告警管理自动化项目。

all.description: Self-hosted multi-project uptime monitoring with user management, encrypted secrets and alerting (Docker / Portainer)
all.descriptionZh: 支持用户管理、加密密钥和告警功能的自托管多项目运行时间监控（Docker / Portainer）

all.description: AttendSphere is a College Attendance Management System developed by Amresh Chaubey. It features real-time attendance tracking, student management, timetable integration, 75% attendance criteria monitoring, defaulter alerts, a bunk calculator, and a student portal. Built to simplify and modernize college attendance management.
all.descriptionZh: AttendSphere 是由 Amresh Chaubey 开发的一款高校考勤管理系统。该系统具备实时考勤跟踪、学生管理、课表集成、75% 考勤标准监控、缺勤提醒、旷课天数计算器以及学生门户等功能。该系统旨在简化并现代化高校考勤管理。

all.description: An IoT-based elderly care system featuring scheduled medication dispensing, ESP32 control, dose acknowledgment, stock monitoring, missed-dose alerts, and caregiver notifications, with a web-based frontend to support safer medication management.
all.descriptionZh: 一款基于物联网的老年人护理系统，具备定时发药、ESP32控制、服药确认、库存监控、漏服提醒及护理人员通知等功能，并配有基于网页的前端界面，以支持更安全的用药管理。

all.description: "A lightweight automated incident management and alerting engine built with Flask, Docker, and Python, featuring real-time system monitoring and webhook-driven incident tracking."
all.descriptionZh: “一个基于 Flask、Docker 和 Python 构建的轻量级自动化事件管理和告警引擎，具备实时系统监控和基于 Webhook 的事件跟踪功能。”

all.description: EcoTrack is an AI and IoT-based smart waste management system that uses YOLOv8 to detect and classify waste as biodegradable or non-biodegradable, enabling automatic segregation, bin-level monitoring, and SMS alerts.
all.descriptionZh: EcoTrack 是一款基于人工智能和物联网的智能垃圾管理系统，它利用 YOLOv8 来检测和分类垃圾（可生物降解或不可生物降解），从而实现自动分类、垃圾桶级别的监控以及短信提醒。

all.description: dashboard designed to analyze and monitor urban development across Vidarbha, including Nagpur, Bhandara, and Gondia. The project focuses on real-time traffic monitoring, air quality (AQI), water management, waste management, and energy usage through interactive dashboards, charts, maps, and alerts to support smarter and more sustainable cities.
all.descriptionZh: 该仪表盘旨在分析和监测维达尔巴地区（包括那格浦尔、班达拉和贡迪亚）的城市发展情况。该项目通过交互式仪表盘、图表、地图和警报，重点关注实时交通监测、空气质量（AQI）、水资源管理、垃圾管理以及能源使用情况，以支持建设更智能、更可持续的城市。

all.description: CyberShield is a Python tool that detects suspicious activity using predefined rules and risk levels. Its desktop interface displays alerts and history, while SQLite stores records for review. The project demonstrates cybersecurity monitoring, Python programming, and database management in practice.
all.descriptionZh: CyberShield 是一款 Python 工具，它利用预定义的规则和风险等级来检测可疑活动。其桌面界面用于显示警报和历史记录，而 SQLite 则用于存储供后续审查的记录。该项目展示了网络安全监控、Python 编程和数据库管理的实际应用。

all.description: Microsoft Azure practical guide covering compute services, Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, disks, storage accounts, Azure Monitor, alerts, Log Analytics, and Backup. Learn cloud infrastructure deployment, networking, storage management, monitoring, and disaster recovery through hands-on projects.
all.descriptionZh: 一本涵盖 Microsoft Azure 计算服务、虚拟机、虚拟网络、磁盘、存储帐户、Azure Monitor、警报、日志分析以及备份的实用指南。通过动手实践项目，学习云基础设施部署、网络配置、存储管理、监控和灾难恢复。

all.description: An intuitive Expense Tracker that empowers users to monitor daily spending, set budget goals, and visualize financial habits with real-time analytics. Features instant transaction logging, category breakdowns, and smart budget alerts to make personal money management effortless and stress-free.
all.descriptionZh: 一款直观的开支追踪应用，帮助用户监控日常开支、设定预算目标，并通过实时分析直观呈现财务习惯。该应用具备即时交易记录、分类明细和智能预算提醒等功能，让个人理财变得轻松无压力。

all.description: AI-powered construction monitoring SaaS that tracks progress, budgets, and delays in real time, with BOQ management, smart alerts, delay prediction, and Claude-generated project summaries. Built on Angular 21, .NET 10, and MySQL.
all.descriptionZh: 一款基于人工智能的建筑监理SaaS平台，可实时跟踪工程进度、预算和延误情况，并具备工程量清单管理、智能提醒、延误预测以及由Claude生成的项目摘要等功能。该平台基于Angular 21、.NET 10和MySQL构建。

all.description: This project uses YOLOv8-based computer vision technology to detect products on retail shelves, identify empty shelf gaps, and count available items. It automatically generates low-stock alerts, helping retailers improve inventory management and reduce manual monitoring efforts.
all.descriptionZh: 该项目利用基于YOLOv8的计算机视觉技术，检测零售货架上的商品、识别空缺位置并统计可用商品数量。它能自动生成库存不足警报，帮助零售商优化库存管理并减少人工监控工作量。

all.description: CloudTask is a cloud-based task management REST API built with Python Flask and Microsoft Azure. It uses Azure App Service, SQL Database, Blob Storage, Queue Storage, and Key Vault, with managed identity, RBAC, monitoring, alerting, and governance features for secure and maintainable cloud application design.
all.descriptionZh: CloudTask 是一个基于云的任务管理 REST API，采用 Python Flask 和 Microsoft Azure 构建。它使用 Azure 应用服务、SQL 数据库、Blob 存储、队列存储和密钥库，并具备托管身份、基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）、监控、警报和治理功能，以实现安全且易于维护的云应用程序设计。

all.description: BloodBridge is a technology-driven blood management platform designed to help improve blood availability by supporting blood demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, low-stock alerts, and donor matching. The project integrates machine learning techniques, including XGBoost, to analyze historical blood demand data and predict future requirements.
all.descriptionZh: BloodBridge 是一个以技术为驱动的血液管理平台，旨在通过支持血液需求预测、库存监控、库存不足预警以及捐献者匹配等功能，帮助提高血液供应量。该项目整合了包括 XGBoost 在内的机器学习技术，用于分析历史血液需求数据并预测未来需求。

all.description: MotorVibe demonstrates a full-stack web application for industrial motor condition monitoring. Its dashboard combines plant overview, motor management, live telemetry, alerts, maintenance planning and reports in one interface. The project uses a React and TypeScript frontend with a Node.js and Express backend and a PostgreSQL database.
all.descriptionZh: MotorVibe 展示了一个用于工业电机状态监测的全栈 Web 应用程序。其仪表盘将工厂概览、电机管理、实时遥测、警报、维护计划和报告整合到一个界面中。该项目采用 React 和 TypeScript 构建前端，Node.js 和 Express 构建后端，并使用 PostgreSQL 数据库。

all.description: A robust, real-time inventory management system designed to track stock levels, monitor product movement, and automate low-stock alerts. This project streamlines supply chain operations by providing a centralized dashboard to manage items, categories, and stock history, minimizing manual data entry errors and preventing stockouts.
all.descriptionZh: 这是一个功能强大的实时库存管理系统，旨在追踪库存水平、监控产品流动并自动触发低库存警报。该项目通过提供一个集中式仪表盘来管理商品、类别和库存历史，从而优化供应链运营，最大限度地减少人工录入错误，并防止缺货。

momentumRanking.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

newProjects.description: Keep your AI coding agents on track and in context. Open-source checker for code written by Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI: 89 rules for security and privacy problems, mapped to OWASP, the EU AI Act and GDPR. CLI, MCP server and GitHub Action. Runs locally, sends nothing.

Private, offline AI for Android and Windows: run local LLMs (Gemma 4, Qwen, Ternary Bonsai, any GGUF) with llama.cpp on CUDA or Vulkan, create images and videos on your own GPU, talk hands-free with on-device voice, run parallel agents, cite web research, pair phone and PC, serve an OpenAI-compatible API. No account, no cloud.
